title: Made a playable version of an old game idea
author: MalvadoEZY
selftext:
Hey guys,

I've made a few games in Unity before and have been working in software development a decade and with AI tools around now, I thought I'd have another go at an idea I started in Unity ages ago. The scope was far too big at the time, so I ended up leaving it.

I've been working on this for just under a month, with massive help of the AI and some stuff i already had back in the days. It's a mix of RuneScape, Metin2's hack and slash style, and some of that satisfying Vampire Survivors combat. At least that's what I was aiming for ahah.

Would love for you to give it a go and let me know what you think. Feedback, ideas, anything really. I've been having quite a bit of fun playing it myself tbh, so thought I'd share it with you

You can try it yourself using a guest account if you would like

[kavor.io](http://kavor.io/)

Thanks
